integrity: The theorem is proved by explicit field-independent matrix identities. Finite-field exhaustive checks are corroborative only and are not used as a proof for arbitrary fields.
scientific_limitations: Classifies the six-dimensional cell c21=c23=c31=0, not all 3x3 perturbations. Literature searches cannot establish absolute novelty; the 2013 article was inspected through abstract/metadata rather than full text.
title: Exact strictness boundary on a six-dimensional Roth rank-minimization cell
